v.name: Rajiv Dube
v.bio: Mr. Rajiv Dube is an Indian industry veteran with over 40 years of multi -sector experience, having served at the highest echelons of two Indian conglomerates - Tata and Aditya Birla. An engineer and a post-graduate in Business Management, he began his career on the shop floor of Tata Motors and rose to be President of its car business before joining the group board of the Aditya Birla group as an executive director, on which he remaine d for nearly nine years. He has served on several other Indian and foreign boards in various capacities over 25 years and brings deep insights in corporate governance, management and transformation of businesses as varied as auto, metals, mining, power and renewables, cement, trading, textiles, retail and financial services. An avid sustainability champion, he was an alternate Council Member of the World Business Council for Sustainable Development (WBCSD) Geneva and has been active on several industry bodies. Currently, Mr. Dube is an Independent Director on Boards, an advis ory board member and professor of practice at the Deakin Business School, Melbourne and a senior advisor to firms in India and Australia.

v.name: Kalpana Merchant
v.bio: Ms. Kalpana Merchant has over 45 years of experience in the legal profession. She has significant experience in dealing with the commercial property matters. Her experience also spans diverse practice areas, including infrastructure, project finance and banking, dispute resolution, capital markets, and mergers and acquisitions, including joint ventures. She has been associated with, and has been a partner at, Kanga & Co., AZB & Partners and Jerome Merchant + Partners. She holds a Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.) degree and a Bachelor of Arts degree with a major in Psychology and is a qualified solicitor.
